Next, move closer to the router and test if the drops still happen, since distance and walls can weaken the signal. After that, check for router firmware updates in the router’s admin page and install any available updates. Then change the Wi-Fi channel or switch from a crowded 2.4 gigahertz band to 5 gigahertz if your devices support it.
